build_VectorEnv: build a VectorEnv with multiple parallel Habitat environments using a custom make_env_fn and env_fn_args
create_ThreadedVectorEnv: create a ThreadedVectorEnv that runs multiple environments in threads inside a single process for debugging
run_VectorEnv_step: run step on all vectorized environments by passing a list of actions to VectorEnv.step
test_VectorEnv_reset: test resetting all vectorized environments and collecting observations from each worker process
call_VectorEnv_call_at: call an arbitrary function or property on a specific environment by index using VectorEnv.call_at
